date_note: Informburo's 24 November report gives no earlier day for the listing or the briefing.
exec: A seller claims to hold Supreme Court of Kazakhstan data; the ministry and the KNB are checking it and nothing is confirmed.
plain: A seller on a dark web marketplace claims to have a Supreme Court of Kazakhstan database. Officials say they are checking whether the claim is true.

sources.name: Informburo: Минцифры и КНБ проверяют информацию о возможной утечке данных Верховного суда

evidence.quote: утверждал, что она содержит 507 млн записей за период с 2014 по 2026 годы

summary: Informburo reports that SOCRadar's darknet monitoring team found a listing on a dark web marketplace for a database allegedly belonging to the Supreme Court of Kazakhstan. The seller, alias "Brose", claimed it contains records for the period 2014 to 2026. Minister Zhaslan Madiyev said at a government briefing that a check is under way, with the KNB involved; the claim is unverified.
title: Seller claims Supreme Court of Kazakhstan database; ministry and KNB checking

validation.note: Only Informburo read; it relays SOCRadar's finding and the minister's statement.

review.note: summary: check by ministry with KNB restated closer to Informburo; other facts match
